panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Shortest uptime across selected pods; drops on restart.

targets.expr: sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", application="$application", pod=~"$pod", status=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", application="$application", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)

sum(jvm_memory_used_bytes{namespace="$namespace", application="$application", pod=~"$pod", area="heap"}) / sum(jvm_memory_max_bytes{namespace="$namespace", application="$application", pod=~"$pod", area="heap"} > 0)

panels.title: Avg latency by endpoint
panels.description: sum/count. No percentiles: histogram buckets are not enabled for http.server.requests.

targets.expr: sum by (method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_sum{namespace="$namespace", application="$application", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", application="$application", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (method, uri, status) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", application="$application", pod=~"$pod", status=~"4.."}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (method, uri, status, exception) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{namespace="$namespace", application="$application", pod=~"$pod", status=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: GC pause time / s
panels.description: Fraction of each second spent paused in GC.

panels.title: Connection usage time
panels.description: How long connections are held before being returned (≈ transaction duration).

panels.title: Tomcat sessions
panels.description: App auth is token-based, so HTTP sessions should stay near zero.
